_notes: What a religious house will do for a parish, and what it asks in return (DESIGN §9.4a). A favour is gated on the standing a priest has built; an ask is answered yes or no, and silence is a no.

favours.label: Ask them to pray for the parish by name
favours.blurb: They write the parish into the book they read from, and keep it there for a year.
favours.gives: the people know that somebody is praying for them who has never met them

favours.label: Ask for a confessor every Saturday
favours.blurb: A friar drives out for the Saturday hours, indefinitely, and hears the people who will not come to their own pastor.
favours.gives: most of the confessions hour back, and a box that is never empty

favours.label: Take your own retreat at their house
favours.blurb: Eight days in the guest wing at their table, with a director, for nothing.
favours.gives: the canonical retreat, properly made, and the week it takes out of you paid back

favours.label: Ask them to preach a parish mission
favours.blurb: Five nights, a preacher who does this forty weeks a year, and confessions until eleven at night.
favours.gives: a parish that is different in April, and a line at the confessional on the Wednesday

favours.label: Ask them to cover the parish when you are away
favours.blurb: One of theirs says your Masses while you are gone, and they will not take a stipend for it.
favours.gives: a retreat or a fortnight that costs the parish nothing

favours.label: Ask the provincial for a priest of theirs for the parish
favours.blurb: An order man in your rectory for some years: their rule, their habit, their provincial, and your parish.
favours.gives: two blocks of the week back, and a second priest in the house

asks.label: Their chaplain is ill
asks.blurb: They need a priest for the community Mass four mornings a week until their own man is back on his feet.
asks.costs: an hour a day for a couple of months, and the drive

asks.label: A collection for their missions
asks.blurb: One Sunday, a second collection, and a friar to speak at every Mass about a house in Guatemala.
asks.costs: a Sunday of the plate, and the people who mind being asked

asks.label: Their novena in your church
asks.blurb: Nine evenings of their devotion in your church, with their preacher and their people, some of whom are not yours.
asks.costs: nine evenings of the church, and the sacristan

asks.label: Back them with the chancery
asks.blurb: The diocese wants their property for a school site and they would like a pastor of the diocese to say, in writing, what the house is worth.
asks.costs: a letter with your name on it, in a file, against the chancery

asks.label: Take a man of theirs for a while
asks.blurb: One of their young men needs parish experience and a room, and they are asking you rather than the chancery.
asks.costs: a room, a summer, and a man who is not yours to form
